reviews.title: Worth it, especially at this price point!
reviews.comment: This is a quality headset - I've tried the V2 Pro for PC, the V2 Pro for Playstation, the V3 for Xbox, and the V3 for PC - this is the best of the bunch (I've got the black PC version, renewed from Amazon). The price point is really attractive and makes this a no-brainer. Compared to the other V2/V3 headsets, the V3 Pro has more base, and the highs are more clear. The V2 Pro sounds a bit faded and has more limited connectivity options, and sound is more muffled, while the V3 sounds OK but my ears touch the back wall, and the overall sound/base isn't as rich or deep or immersive. The noise cancellation on the V3 Pro helps with keyboard typing and mouse clicks - it won't win any awards, but it's a nice feature that helps when I'm working from home, and all together cancels out more noise than the other V2/V3 headsets. The boom mic is great for work calls, and Razer Synapse allows for adjustable background noise cancelling on the mic. This connects to Bluetooth as well, and works great with the Razer Audio app, although I'm not sure the mic and sound enhancements work on Bluetooth audio, but the equalizer works great on Bluetooth. Battery life is good, and the swivels are great since the other V2/V3 have an integrated connection that tends to break over time, the swivel seems to alleviate that possible issue down the road. This headset really immerses me into my gaming, has good overall audio for music and work, and is comfortable (although a bit heavy). Overall worth it!
reviews.author: Benjamin

reviews.comment: Husband definitely loves them, the sound quality is fabulous, they are so comfortable he falls asleep with them all the time, they have great noise control he streams and you can’t hear our kids in the next room yelling or moving chairs around.

reviews.title: Awesome Headset
reviews.comment: The sound quality is great. The noise reduction works well. I was all in all impressed with the amount of features and general condition of the headset itself. I love that it connects to both your phone and PC at the same time. This way you can take calls while gaming on the same headset! It is just as comfortable as the V2 Pro (which I accidently broke, thus the upgrade) Just one thing, I did not receive the little mic cover with it. I seem to have everything else and that is really an issue with the seller. I just need to figure out how to contact them and see if they would be nice enough to send me a mic puff.
